name: Lean HTTP stack: Std.Http, stdhttp-verify, LeanServer
subject: HTTP/1.1 request framing and parsing (RFC 9112) in Lean's Std.Http; full HTTPS/TLS 1.3 server (LeanServer)
impl_language: Lean 4 (patched copy of shipped Std.Http; bounded native_decide equivalence and HTTP Garden differential testing to shipped code)

tcb.unverified_translator: hand-translated connection-loop model (Loop.lean); libuv IPv6 parse as hypothesis. LeanServer separately: 5 axioms, 3 of shape forall s, s = const (inconsistent on static reading), ~379 native_decide, OpenSSL FFI

pattern: differential testing finds bug, then totalise partial loops in a copy and prove grammar soundness/completeness, all-operation-sequence invariants and segmentation independence; bounded equivalence back to shipped code
